It has risen about 360% since launch, and its all-time high was about $23k market cap. Its description is a crude sexual joke about Bonnie Blue, a British adult-content creator. It says trading fees go to @bonnieblue_xoxo through UsePaid, a service that redirects creator fees to a celebrity. Nothing shows she is involved or has endorsed it. GMGN tags 77 of the traders as bundler wallets and 64 as fresh wallets. The creator has closed their position. The dev's X account is linked to 100 launched tokens. The packet's GMGN promotion data flags the token as a community takeover.
